oddities.label: One-point safety
oddities.why: A blocked or botched PAT ends up dead in the kicking team's own end zone. It's the rarest scoring play in the sport -- as far as we know it has never actually happened in an NFL game, though the rule allows it.

oddities.label: Kick-six
oddities.why: A missed field goal returned the length of the field for a touchdown. The kick has to land short in the field of play, and the returner has to go 100+ yards.

oddities.label: 99-yard touchdown
oddities.why: The play starts at the offense's own 1-yard line and goes the entire field. It's the longest scrimmage play possible.

oddities.label: Defensive 2-point return
oddities.why: The defense takes a failed two-point try back to the other end zone and scores 2 points of its own.

oddities.label: Multi-lateral touchdown
oddities.why: Several backward passes on one play that end in a touchdown. Usually a last-gasp desperation play that almost never works.

oddities.label: QB catches a pass
oddities.why: A quarterback lines up as a receiver (often a trick play) and actually catches the ball.

oddities.label: Walk-off score
oddities.why: The game-winning score comes with no time left on the clock.

oddities.label: Blocked punt/FG touchdown
oddities.why: The defense blocks a punt or field goal and scores on the same play.

oddities.label: Fake punt/FG touchdown
oddities.why: A fake punt or field goal that goes all the way for a touchdown, often with a punter, holder or kicker making the play.

oddities.label: 60+ yard field goal
oddities.why: Field goals from 60+ yards are made only a handful of times each season, though they're getting more common.

oddities.label: Onside kick recovered
oddities.why: The kicking team recovers its own short kickoff. Success rates are low, especially when the other team is expecting it.

oddities.label: Offensive fumble recovery TD
oddities.why: The offense fumbles and recovers its own ball in the end zone for a touchdown.

oddities.label: Non-QB touchdown pass
oddities.why: A trick-play pass thrown by someone other than the quarterback that goes for a touchdown.

oddities.label: Safety
oddities.why: The offense is downed or commits a foul in its own end zone. The defense gets 2 points and the ball back.

oddities.label: Pick-six
oddities.why: An interception returned for a touchdown.

oddities.label: Overtime score
oddities.why: A touchdown, field goal, or safety scored in overtime.

Defensive Delay of Game.why: Called only a handful of times this season.

Disqualification.why: A player is ejected from the game outright, rather than just penalized.

Fair Catch Interference.why: Called only a handful of times this season.

Horse Collar Tackle.why: A tackler grabs the inside back of the collar or shoulder pads and pulls the runner down.

Illegal Double-Team Block.why: Called only a handful of times this season.

Illegal Forward Handoff.why: A backward pass (lateral) that actually went forward, ruled an illegal handoff.

Illegal Forward Pass.why: Called only a handful of times this season.

Illegal Motion.why: Called only a handful of times this season.

Illegal Substitution.why: Called only a handful of times this season.

Illegal Touch Kick.why: A kicking-team player illegally touches a punt or kick before the receiving team does.

Illegal Touch Pass.why: An ineligible receiver, or a receiver out of bounds, touches a forward pass first.

Ineligible Downfield Kick.why: Called only a handful of times this season.

Invalid Fair Catch Signal.why: A returner signals for a fair catch without clearly and unmistakably raising an arm.

Leverage.why: Using a teammate's body to gain height while trying to block a kick. It almost never gets called.

Low Block.why: Called only a handful of times this season.

Lowering the Head to Make Forcible Conta.why: Called only a handful of times this season.

Offensive Too Many Men on Field.why: Called only a handful of times this season.

Player Out of Bounds on Kick.why: Called only a handful of times this season.

Roughing the Kicker.why: Called only a handful of times this season.

Running Into the Kicker.why: Incidental contact with the kicker that falls short of roughing. Rarely flagged.

Tripping.why: Called only a handful of times this season.
